desc: Implement DSU with path compression and union by size.
Count nums[i] > threshold as isolated components.
Build dict mapping value → index for numbers ≤ threshold (unique).
For each a in small_numbers, for multiple in range(a, threshold+1, a): append index to bucket[multiple].
Iterate multiples from 1 to threshold: union all indices in bucket[multiple].
Count unique DSU roots among small_numbers indices.
Consider edge cases: n=1, all numbers > threshold, threshold=1.
